dedup_views.D0: all unique source IDs; descriptive custody view only
dedup_views.D1_PRIMARY: within exact host × year, collapse byte-exact content.body duplicates deterministically by lexicographically smallest source id
dedup_views.D2_SENSITIVITY: global byte-exact body collapse; never primary because syndicated/repeated text across hosts/years may be historically meaningful

composition_controls: language and script never silently pooled in primary trajectories
publisher/host never silently pooled in primary trajectories
topic/category composition reported when metadata permits
natural-mixture and common-support views kept distinct

temporal_tests.qfid: exact quotient/fiber JS decomposition on each matched trajectory
temporal_tests.path_efficiency: presealed sqrt(JS) direct-distance / sum-step-distance diagnostic for >=4-year trajectories
temporal_tests.horizon_profiles: same-start y→y+h comparisons only where all intermediate years are present

prohibitions: selecting publishers/years after seeing EDF/QFID outcomes
normalizing Old Hangeul/Hanja into modern forms for R0/R1
treating script change as style drift
promoting EDF classes to semantic-function gold
using global duplicate collapse as primary historical law
